-- 查询总用户数
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_users FROM users;

-- 查询今天注册的用户
SELECT COUNT(*) as today_registrations 
FROM users 
WHERE DATE(createdAt) = CURDATE();

-- 查询最近7天注册的用户
SELECT COUNT(*) as week_registrations 
FROM users 
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);

-- 查询所有用户的基本信息
SELECT id, name, email, role, createdAt, lastSignedIn 
FROM users 
ORDER BY createdAt DESC;

-- 查询今天的使用记录
SELECT COUNT(*) as today_usage 
FROM usage_records 
WHERE DATE(createdAt) = CURDATE();

-- 查询总使用次数
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_usage FROM usage_records;

-- 查询流量追踪统计
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_visits FROM traffic_sources;

-- 查询今天的访问量
SELECT COUNT(*) as today_visits 
FROM traffic_sources 
WHERE DATE(visitedAt) = CURDATE();
